response.transport: streamable-http (stateless, JSON responses); one POST per request at the exact path /mcp
response.credentials: Public reads need no credential. Per request: `Authorization: Bearer <your operator credential>` header ONLY. Never a query string, tool argument or resource; never returned. Each request is authenticated and acts as its own principal; the server holds no shared token. A credential that fails verification is refused, never treated as anonymous. Every write tool needs a valid bearer.

tools.name: frontier_search
tools.summary: Search public records: GIN full-text plus literal text, exact version/id/source pins, kind/status/source/scope/context filters, bounded pages (max 50). Lexical only, no embeddings; relevance is not truth.

tools.name: frontier_get
tools.summary: Retrieve one exact public version and its separate node-local review status.

tools.name: frontier_neighborhood
tools.summary: Read up to 50 typed edges at depth one, including review/dispute relationships.

tools.name: frontier_events
tools.summary: Read an append-only public event page; consumers deduplicate event versions.

tools.name: frontier_artifacts
tools.summary: Find public artifact declarations with evidence, action, context and review links. Does not fetch or verify bytes.

tools.name: frontier_discover
tools.summary: Search with cached hybrid vectors when available; otherwise explicitly fall back to lexical search, without provider calls.

tools.name: frontier_graph
tools.summary: Read a bounded public graph view around an exact version, or an overview; returns typed edges and truncation counts.

tools.name: frontier_catalogue
tools.summary: Return measured public-catalogue counts, unknown categories, and the report's record cap.

tools.name: frontier_project_inspect
tools.summary: Inspect one exact Project version and its pinned members; newer heads are reported, never substituted.

tools.name: frontier_design_context
tools.summary: Read bounded exact-version Project/member annotations with explicit pagination; challenges and replies never settle or resolve the design.

tools.name: frontier_artifact_inspect
tools.summary: Inspect matching Evidence declarations and check for matching bytes in this release's guarded public artifacts tree.

tools.name: frontier_simulate
tools.summary: Run one bounded allowlisted bioelectric or mechanobiology preview; returns an ephemeral SimulationResult, never accepted Evidence.

tools.name: frontier_engineer
tools.summary: Run the existing bounded engineering-constraint solver; returns an ephemeral scoped calculation, not a biological finding.

tools.name: frontier_formalize
tools.summary: Run the bounded exact-expression/Lean proposal service; the result is not a persisted formal Evidence record.

tools.name: frontier_belief
tools.summary: Run the bounded finite-scenario belief solver; consequences are conditional on declared inputs and remain uncalibrated.

tools.name: frontier_capabilities
tools.summary: Manifest of this server: mode, configured principal (never the credential), exact tools, limits and what is deliberately unavailable.

tools.name: frontier_propose
tools.summary: Propose a record version as the configured principal. The result is 'proposed', never accepted; Events are emitted by the store only.

tools.name: frontier_lease
tools.summary: Atomically lease one 'ready' (or expired) Action version for 1..600 seconds. Returns lease_id for later transitions.

tools.name: frontier_transition
tools.summary: Move an Action through the execution lifecycle (ready, running, submitted, blocked, cancelled, failed). Acceptance is not reachable here.

not_available: review / accept / dispute: independent reviewers act through HTTP POST /v1/reviews with their own operator credential
cloud or durable job execution, arbitrary code, network fetch, publication, and external model inference
the fixed local calculation tools are bounded previews only; they do not create or accept Actions or Evidence
proposed Actions are stored as proposed; a worker must use the existing authorized lease/transition flow and record real outputs separately
response.schema_resources: frontier://schema/{kind} returns that kind's payload JSON schema

search.engine: PostgreSQL full-text (simple dictionary, GIN-indexed) plus literal substring fallback; lexical only, no embeddings, no hybrid; relevance is not truth
search.pagination: opaque next_cursor, pass back as cursor (or legacy after)

response.lease_id_note: A lease_id is a bearer capability for that lease: keep it inside the leasing agent's session. It is not logged by this server.
response.write_semantics: Writes return the store's response verbatim: records start 'proposed'; MCP cannot make anything 'accepted'.

payload.title: Declared-load critical bending stiffness of a single clamped-free ray (linear small-deformation surrogate)

source.access: Public repository file at an immutable commit (git locator in the title/locator). Only digests are carried; bytes are not embedded and no licence for the content is stated by this record. Claim statement is the producer's critical_stiffness field.

payload.context: Producer-derived number from exact rational arithmetic on DECLARED inputs (rho, V, CL, tributary width, ray length, validity thresholds). It is a threshold of the surrogate, not a property of any fish. Decision rule stated by the producer: If measured EI >= EI_crit_Nm2 the declared load stays inside the small-deformation limit for this geometry; if EI < EI_crit_Nm2 the linear model is invalid at the declared load and a large-deformation model (or a lower load) is required.
payload.statement: For the producer's declared request (canonical sha256 f276a86069b8577d...), in a linear static Euler-Bernoulli cantilever with a uniform line load from a declared lift-pressure proxy, the bending stiffness below which the declared small-deformation limits are exceeded is EI_crit = 1323/2048000 N m^2 (binding limit: tip_over_L).
assumptions: Euler-Bernoulli (no shear deformation), linear elastic, static, constant EI along the ray
single clamped-free cantilever ray; clamped base; free tip
load = mean aerodynamic lift-pressure proxy p = 0.5*rho*V^2*CL from DECLARED rho, V, CL; uniform along the ray and normal to it; NOT a measured fin pressure
line load q_line = p * tributary width (width declared, see load_bridge.inputs)
EI swept over an ASSUMED log-spaced range [1/1000000, 1] N m^2, 61 points; no biological calibration
small-deformation validity limits are DECLARED thresholds, not derived from material
limitations: Imported record of what the producer's receipt reports. Frontier did not execute this and no one has re-run it; the producer's own code produced both the claim and the result, so it is not independent evidence.
The request is labelled by its producer: DECLARED ILLUSTRATION: not produced by the dx-guilds solver; numbers are test values, not a design claim. Its numbers are test values, not a design claim.
EI is an ASSUMED log-spaced range (1/1000000 to 1 N m^2), not a measurement of any fin ray.
Producer states it does not establish: biological feasibility of any fin, ray or flight design
Producer states it does not establish: the stiffness EI of any real fish fin ray (it is an assumed range here)
Producer states it does not establish: fluid-structure interaction: the load is a fixed mean pressure proxy, not coupled to deformation
Producer states it does not establish: fin membrane, bilaminar hemitrich shear, active muscle control, ray taper, joints or viscoelasticity
Producer states it does not establish: large-deformation (elastica) behaviour: results beyond the declared small-deformation limit are flagged invalid
Producer states it does not establish: calibration of rho, CL, tributary width or ray length (all declared, none measured)
Producer states it does not establish: that the glide package's candidate is flyable (owned by the glide receipt, not by this package)

payload.title: Exact-Claim consumed before calculation: below-threshold illustrative ray stiffness candidate
acceptance_criteria: Exact source Claim and historical request pins verified before compute
Fixed quadrature/null/mutant/FEM controls pass or failures retained
Actual derived stiffness and invalid/valid model-domain outcome preserved
Output hashes and exact Action producer recorded; independent review required
payload.cost_stop_bounds: One CPU/thread,4GiB,128tasks,600s whole process; no cloud/GPU/network solver. Stop on pin mismatch or numerical-control failure; invalid candidate remains visible.

cache_key.model: existing static Euler-Bernoulli beam and declared load bridge
cache_key.scope: Two illustrative mathematical stiffness candidates under one already published exact Claim context; not measured fish biology, collective benefit or biological validation.

proposal.method: Before each numerical run fetch exact Claim via official MCP, verify Record digest/ref, parse EI_crit rational from statement, verify original result/request scope, multiply parsed value by case margin to construct actual solver EI. No hardcoded fallback stiffness. Reuse installed beam adapter.
assumptions: Original declared illustration context only; critical stiffness Claim remains unreviewed
Selected EI is an assumed design parameter, not measured ray stiffness

alternatives.label: lower-load
alternatives.description: Reduce the fixed load rather than increase EI
alternatives.tradeoff: Changes original Claim context and requires another protocol

proposal.expected_information: Does this lower-stiffness candidate violate the declared small-deformation domain?
proposal.decision_context: Keep or reject a stiffness candidate within the stated linear-model domain; no fish feasibility decision
expected_outputs: Effective input binding, beam profile, result/control and provenance receipts
controls: Existing beam.control_residuals versus independent quadrature
Zero load yields zero displacement
Wrong uniform-law L^3 mutant rejected by quadrature control
Missing/altered Claim ref or source context fails before solve
Mutating parsed critical value changes derived candidate EI; full scope gate rejects inconsistency
proposal.analysis_plan: Compare16/32/64element profiles with existing analytic solution; preserve every model-domain flag and fixed control outcome.

outcomes.label: inside-domain
outcomes.decision_consequence: Retain as illustrative linear-model candidate only

outcomes.label: outside-domain
outcomes.decision_consequence: Reject this linear-model candidate; do not interpret invalid deformation biologically

proposal.selection_rationale: Two predeclared stiffness margins from the same consumed exact Claim; no utility/agency comparison
limitations: Two illustrative mathematical stiffness candidates under one already published exact Claim context; not measured fish biology, collective benefit or biological validation.
Shared source/model/conditions; no biological calibration or independent samples
